title: Independent SDSS DR20 young-versus-old 3D current-field test with open-cluster control

allowed_scientific_inputs: SDSS DR20 gyrochronology-age dwarf VAC gyro_age_dwarf-1.0.0.fits
Gaia DR3 gaia_source rows joined by exact source_id
SDSS DR20 BOSS OCCAM cluster VAC BOSS_occam_cluster-DR20-v1.fits
SDSS DR20 OB-star kinematics VAC ob_vac-1.0.0.fits for coverage audit only
independence_boundary.rule: No threshold, grid, cohort, statistic, or interpretation rule may be changed after a real young-old current contrast is evaluated. Schema-only adapters must be documented and cannot inspect outcome values.

gyro.role: sole age catalog for both primary cohorts

ob_kinematics.role: coverage and coordinate sanity audit only; never merged into the primary statistic

clusters.role: orthogonal control; never used to tune the field test

cohorts.age_errors: finite, non-negative 1-sigma lower and upper errors; a documented symmetric catalog error may populate both sides

velocity_components: v_phi standardized positive for median prograde disk rotation

current_estimator.guardrail: Catalog counts are selection-function tracer densities, not a calibrated stellar mass density. The selection-balanced contrast is primary.

primary_statistic.definition: For each supported voxel, compute the squared Mahalanobis distance between old and young mean 3D velocity/current vectors using the sum of their mean covariance matrices; T is the equal-voxel mean distance.
primary_statistic.null: Within each supported voxel, permute the young/old labels while preserving the observed cohort counts.

secondary_outputs: per-voxel young and old rho, mean velocity, raw J, and selection-balanced J

open_cluster_control.catalog: SDSS DR20 BOSS OCCAM cluster VAC v1
open_cluster_control.inclusion: finite age, present radius, and guiding radius; Num_Full_Members >= 3 when present
open_cluster_control.null: globally permute cluster ages relative to the fixed offsets

interpretation.field_null: The block supplies no young-old current-field evidence for persistence.
interpretation.field_rejection_cluster_positive: Age cohorts have different matched current fields, but the positive orbital-offset control flags conventional age-dependent disk dynamics as a live confound; do not promote as persistence evidence.
interpretation.field_rejection_cluster_null: Persistence-compatible independent anomaly, but not a direct acceleration measurement and not sufficient by itself to establish persistence.
interpretation.prohibited_claim: Neither a field rejection nor a null cluster control may be described as a detection of gravitational persistence.
